in_sanskrit.name: चक्रि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Chakri in Sanskrit is derived from the word चक्र (chakra), which means circle, disc, or wheel. This name is often associated with the celestial wheel of time or the divine wheel of Shiva. It can also refer to a circular ornament or a weapon with revolving blades.
